title: Quick-fill Malta expense planner
intro: A blank-by-default planner for 13–19 October 2026. Enter euros on a consistent whole-trip or party basis, preview itinerary matches and record each cost once. Published references are not personal quotes; no amount, purchase, ride count, party size or reimbursement is assumed.

records.name: Flights — all travelers
records.address: Not applicable — editable expense category
records.hours: Not applicable
records.price range: Not published; budget and actual fields start blank
records.description: Enter the booked round-trip total, including baggage, seat selection, payment fees, and any changes. Departure airport, airline, traveler count, and booking price have not been provided; do not assume a U.S. gateway or flight itinerary.
records.notes: Malta Airport’s airline directory is for route/provider discovery, not a fare quote. Enter the total from the selected airline’s booking or receipt; if charged in USD, convert using the card/statement rate and note the conversion or fee.

records.name: AX ODYCY — full accommodation booking total
records.address: AX ODYCY, Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902, Malta
records.hours: Not applicable — enter the full booking total and note the confirmed check-in/out dates
records.price range: Not published; booking amount starts blank
records.description: Hotel and Deluxe Sea-View room are user-supplied trip details. No booking confirmation, price, deposit, meal plan, traveler count, or exact check-in/out time was supplied. Enter the confirmed booking total rather than multiplying an assumed nightly rate; do not infer the number of hotel nights from the travel window alone.
records.notes: Official AX ODYCY property page; it is not a quote or confirmation of this reservation. Record any included meals, deposit, cancellation terms, and separately billed hotel charges in the notes field.

records.name: Hotel taxes, environmental contribution, deposits, or other separately billed charges
records.address: AX ODYCY, Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902, Malta
records.hours: Not applicable
records.price range: €1.50 per person per night for guests aged 18+, maximum €22.50 per person per visit; six chargeable nights would be €9.00 per eligible adult. Not a confirmed charge — verify on the hotel invoice.
records.description: Optional line only for charges shown separately on the confirmed hotel invoice. The Malta Tourism Authority's 2026 guidelines require the eco-contribution to be disclosed separately from accommodation fees on a fiscal receipt, at €1.50 per night per guest aged 18+ at the start of the visit and capped at €22.50 per person per visit. Six billable nights would be €9.00 per eligible adult, but whether it is charged here, when, and to whom depends on the booking and the invoice.
records.notes: The 2026 MTA guidelines were read directly: https://mta.com.mt/docs/Eco-Contribution-Accommodation-Guidelines-2026.pdf . The rate, the age test, the per-person cap, the per-night chargeability (whether or not the room is used) and the separate-receipt rule are all explicit. The guidelines' only fifteen-day reference defines an "interruption" — up to fifteen days in premises that do not require to be licensed within one visit — rather than a minimum stay, which is why the six-night figure is treated as ordinary arithmetic rather than an open question. It is still not a confirmed charge for this traveller: enter an amount only if the invoice shows one. Do not double-count it in another row.

records.name: Local buses / travel cards
records.address: Not applicable — editable expense category
records.hours: Not applicable
records.price range: Not set; check current fares and card conditions
records.description: Enter the total for the travel card or individual bus fares actually planned or purchased. The operator publishes day-route singles and several card products, but the trip-date single fare and the traveler’s actual ride count are not established. Compare prices and product terms with the dated journey plan; no card, pass or “best buy” is recommended or assumed.
records.notes: MPT fare page read in full 11 October 2026: https://www.publictransport.com.mt/fares-and-tickets/ . It lists €2.50 summer / €2.00 winter day-route singles, with a two-hour transfer window and free transfers; the printed winter period ends 13 June 2026 and the page gives no 2026/27 changeover date. It lists €19 for 12 shareable Single Day Journeys, €25 for Explore Adult 7-day, €21/€27 for Explore Flex 4/7-day and €7 Explore Child. The Explore Adult paragraph excludes tallinja Direct; the page also has conflicting Airport Direct wording, so confirm product coverage with MPT. Whether any card saves money depends on actual boardings, dates, traveler eligibility and product terms; no break-even purchase recommendation is made. Sales points shown by MPT include Buġibba Terminal, airport, Valletta Terminal and Sliema Ferries. See getting-around.html#mpt-fares-cards and transport record mpt-seasonal-fare-window-2026.

records.name: AX ODYCY ↔ BLAST Arena Studios event-day travel
records.address: From AX ODYCY, Qawra Coast Road, to the confirmed MFCC/BLAST Arena Studios entrance
records.hours: Not applicable — enter the chosen event-day round-trip amount
records.price range: Not set; exact date/time route and event return are not confirmed
records.description: Track the actual event-day transport cost separately from general bus spending. Route 186 is an outbound candidate from Qawra 952 to Stadium 6227; the return uses opposite-side Stadium 2194 toward Buġibba, ending at Buġibba Bay 1 rather than Qawra. The current static page displays the Buġibba-bound Stadium row through 20:53; the approximately 22:04/22:08 readings belong to the outbound direction at Stadium 6227. These static rows are not date-specific, and no date-specific onward Qawra connection or complete network search was made. This is a return-planning risk, not proof that no bus alternative exists. Check all legs in MPT’s dated planner and enter only the actual ticket, ride quote or receipt after choosing a plan.
records.notes: Eventbrite’s visible agenda on 11 October lists 09:30 check-in / 10:30 games / to 22:30 on Wed 14 and Thu 15 October, and 14:00 / 15:00 / to 21:00 on Fri 16 October; Sat 17 and Sun 18 Eventbrite door rows were not exposed. The current full Route 186 page separates Stadium 2194 Buġibba-bound return (displayed through 20:53) from outbound Stadium 6227 toward Rabat (about 22:08; another nearby outbound reading about 22:04). Neither static row is date-specific. No planner result, onward Buġibba–Qawra connection, attendee gate or measured walk was obtained. MPT lists a 17 October 19:00–00:00 detour cluster and TQ1 still displayed “Timetable not available!” when checked. Use https://www.publictransport.com.mt/journey-planner/ for the selected date and confirm actual costs; do not assume a taxi, bus return or specific fare.

records.name: Taxi / ride-hailing
records.address: Not applicable — enter only trips you plan to take
records.hours: Not applicable
records.price range: Live quote varies; no amount prefilled
records.description: Optional expense category for taxi or ride-hailing trips the traveler actually chooses. No taxi is booked, priced or assumed as the return for every event night. Compare a live route/time quote, car availability and pickup permission with the date-specific public-transport planner; enter the amount only from a current quote or receipt.
records.notes: Transport Malta publishes maximum meter rates, but the page footer states “Page last updated: 06/04/2022”, so treat them as potentially revised: https://www.transport.gov.mt/land/public-transport/other-public-transport/taxis-829 . The approximate caps at assumed 5/10/15/20 km distances are this guide’s arithmetic, excluding waiting and traffic; they are not a Qawra–venue distance or a quote. Ride-hailing is dynamic and not bound by the meter tariff. Compare live Bolt/eCabs/other available-provider quotes, confirm the pickup point and vehicle availability, and use the operator’s date-specific planner for bus alternatives. No event-night ride count, booking or price is assumed.

records.name: Thunderpick event ticket / spectator access, if applicable
records.address: BLAST Arena Studios Malta, MFCC South Gate National Stadium, ATD 4000 Attard, Malta — the address on the event’s own ticketing listing.
records.hours: Wednesday 14 – Sunday 18 October 2026, 9:30 AM – 10 PM. Check-in 09:30 and games 10:30 on 14 and 15 October; check-in 14:00 and games 15:00 on 16 October. Ages 18+.
records.price range: Event-specific admission price, booking fees and reservation status are unconfirmed; no amount is prefilled. Enter a cost only after a current event-specific checkout or organizer confirmation. No ticket or reservation is held by this project.
records.description: This optional row is for event-related spending such as confirmed admission, venue food/drink or merchandise. The current direct Eventbrite extraction did not expose a Thunderpick-specific ticket tier, price, booking action or checkout. A generic recommendation card is not evidence of this event’s price; a secondary report says tickets are free but is not a current checkout quote. Leave the amount blank until the traveler has a confirmed event-specific total; keep transport and other categories in their own rows.
records.notes: Direct Eventbrite read 11 October 2026: https://www.eventbrite.co.uk/e/hotspawn-present-the-thunderpick-world-championships-2026-tickets-1988838616841. The page extraction identifies the event, venue, 14–18 October dates and in-person 18+ highlights, but does not expose an event-specific ticket price, tier, booking action, checkout, current inventory or this traveler’s reservation. A generic “Free / Oct 14–18 / Reserve a spot” card appeared under “You might also like” and cannot be attributed to the Thunderpick event. HLTV’s 2 October report says tickets are free and links to Eventbrite: https://www.hltv.org/news/45615/thunderpick-world-championship-talent-revealed; this is secondary reporting, not a current primary checkout quote. No event access cost is assumed and this planner keeps the amount blank. Confirm the current event-specific price, fees and reservation availability with Hotspawn before entering an amount.
